office: Majority Leader, Rhode Island House of Representatives
label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.

items.t: Said a bill will help guarantee access for everyone in Rhode Island who needs reproductive health services.
items.q: Kazarian said the bill will help guarantee that everyone in Rhode Island who needs reproductive health services will have access.

record.t: Was elected House Majority Leader by the House Democratic Caucus, the first woman to hold the position.
record.q: The House Democratic Caucus today elected Whip Katherine S. Kazarian to serve as the Majority Leader, making her the first woman to serve in the position.

record.t: Sponsored, with Sen. Dawn Euer, a bill to protect domestic violence victims from abusive litigation filed by abusers, which the governor signed.
record.q: A bill sponsored by Sen. Dawn Euer and House Majority Whip Katherine Kazarian that would protect domestic violence victims from abusive litigation filed by abusers has been signed by the governor.

record.t: Has served as State Representative for District 63 since 2012.
record.q: Since 2012, it has been the greatest honor of my life to serve district 63 as a State Representative and to advocate for my neighbors at the State House.

record.t: Was named among the representatives who passed House Bill 6165, "An Act Relating to Taxation – Levy and Assessment of Local Taxes," in the Rhode Island House.
record.q: House Bill 6165 and Senate Bill 885 entitled “An Act Relating to Taxation – Levy and Assessment of Local Taxes” were passed in the Rhode Island House by Representatives Katherine Kazarian, Jennifer Boylan, Matt Dawson and Briana Henries
